purpose: Pre-redaction source-template and near-duplicate pair exclusions, followed by original-only threshold recalibration.
lexical_representation: Remove all gold PII spans, lowercase, normalize non-alphanumeric characters to spaces; hashing-vectorized binary character 5-grams, 2^20 dimensions, L2 norm, cosine.
lexical_near_duplicate_rule: exclude if non-PII skeleton character 5-gram cosine >= each of (0.5, 0.8); 0.5 is the stricter sensitivity analysis
nemotron_type_rule: exclude pairs with identical source document_type metadata
split: Same deterministic 60/40 record-level split as prior calibrated experiment for each dataset; thresholds recalibrated using only eligible original calibration pairs for each universe.
uncertainty: Leave-one-record jackknife for filtered pair proportions; leave-one-document_type-group jackknife for Nemotron different-type universes. These intervals are approximate and do not establish semantic non-equivalence.
